contacts_table_empty_desc: Add one above to get started.
contacts_agent_email_locked_hint: An agent's email is their account key across companies, so it can't be changed here. To fix a typo or move to a new address, archive this agent and add a new one (report links already sent still work).
contacts_agents_empty_desc: Agents you add or import appear here. Grant report access per inspection from the People panel.
contacts_archive_confirm: Removes them from your list. Their inspections and any report links they were sent are unaffected.
contacts_archive_access_warning: This contact can still open {count} report(s). Archiving does not withdraw that.
contacts_archive_access_warning_revoking: Archiving will also revoke the {count} report link(s) this contact still holds.
contacts_detail_history_empty_desc: This contact has no linked inspections yet.
contacts_error_not_found: This contact could not be found. It may have been deleted.
contacts_error_forbidden: You do not have permission to view this contact.
contacts_error_generic: Something went wrong while opening the contact.
contacts_csv_hint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx) — Spectora and ITB exports work out of the box
contacts_csv_failed_desc: The server rejected the import. Nothing was written — try again, and contact support if it persists.
contacts_csv_nothing_desc: The file imports all-or-nothing. Fix the rows below and retry — no duplicates will be created.
contacts_csv_skipped: {count} skipped (blank name or already in your contacts)
contacts_csv_error_legacy_xls: Legacy .xls files aren't supported — save the file as .xlsx or CSV and retry.
contacts_roles_modal_kind_hint: Set on creation and cannot be changed afterward.
contacts_detail_access_none: This contact cannot open any reports.
contacts_detail_access_unavailable: Report access could not be loaded, so this list may be incomplete. Reload before assuming this contact has no access.
contacts_detail_access_revoked_none: Nothing to revoke — those links had already lapsed.
contacts_detail_access_revoke_failed: Could not revoke. Nothing was changed — try again.
contacts_detail_access_explainer: These links work without an account. Revoking one takes effect immediately.
contacts_roles_modal_email_template_hint: Used when you send the report by hand. Leave as None to use the standard report email. Automatic messages are configured under Settings → Automations.
